name: syncanvas
description: Real-time collaborative scene editor (Figma-lite) with a hand-rolled CRDT

scripts.build: npm run build -w @syncanvas/shared && npm run build -w @syncanvas/server && npm run build -w @syncanvas/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @syncanvas/shared" "npm run dev -w @syncanvas/server" "npm run dev -w @syncanvas/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @syncanvas/server && npm run typecheck -w @syncanvas/client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
